info.title: Speko API
info.description: Public REST API for the Speko voice gateway. Routes, transcribes, synthesizes, and completes via the highest-scoring provider for your routing intent, with transparent server-side failover.

post.description: Mints a LiveKit access token, persists the pipeline config, and dispatches an agent worker into the room. Use the returned `conversationToken` and `livekitUrl` with `@spekoai/client` to join the room from a browser.

get.description: Returns sessions visible to the calling key, newest first. Supports cursor pagination and filtering by `status`, `kind`, and `agent`. All filters combine via AND.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a prior call. Omit on the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max number of entries to return.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Filter to sessions started against this agent. Matches sessions whose `pipelineConfig.agentId` equals this value. Combines with other filters via AND.

post.description: Routes the request to the best STT provider for your `(language, optimizeFor)` intent, with automatic failover to runner-up providers. Body is binary audio. Routing intent goes in the `x-speko-intent` header (JSON).

parameters.name: x-speko-constraints
parameters.description: Optional JSON-encoded `PipelineConstraints`. Each `allowedProviders` entry is either `"<vendor>"` (any model from that vendor) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (a specific model). Example: `{"allowedProviders":{"stt":["deepgram:nova-3"]}}`.

requestBody.description: Binary audio. WAV, MP3, or raw PCM accepted.

X-Speko-Provider.description: Provider that actually handled the request.

X-Speko-Failover-Count.description: Number of providers tried before success.

X-Speko-Scores-Run-Id.description: Benchmark snapshot id used for routing.

post.description: Routes the request to the best TTS provider for your intent, with automatic failover. Returns binary audio. The `Content-Type` header (mirrored in `X-Speko-Audio-Format`) tells you the format.

X-Speko-Provider.description: Provider that actually handled the request.

X-Speko-Failover-Count.description: Number of providers tried before success.

X-Speko-Scores-Run-Id.description: Benchmark snapshot id used for routing.

post.description: Single-turn LLM call routed to the best provider for your intent, with automatic failover. Returns assistant text + token usage.

X-Speko-Provider.description: Provider that actually handled the request.

X-Speko-Failover-Count.description: Number of providers tried before success.

X-Speko-Scores-Run-Id.description: Benchmark snapshot id used for routing.

get.description: Returns every agent belonging to the authenticated organization, including the seed `Default` agent. Agents are scoped per-org — IDs from another org will never appear here.

200.description: Agents owned by the authenticated organization.

post.description: Persists a reusable voice persona — `systemPrompt`, optional `voice`, routing `intent`, and optional `llmOptions` — keyed by `name` within the authenticated organization. Pass the returned `id` as `agentId` on `POST /v1/sessions` to seed a session from this agent.

get.description: Fetch a single agent by id. Scoped to the authenticated organization — agents owned by another org always return 404.

patch.description: Partial update — every field on the body is optional and only supplied keys are written. The seed `Default` agent's `name` cannot be changed; other fields can. Updating `name` to one already used by another agent in the org returns 409.

delete.description: Removes the agent and FK-cascades to any registered tools. The seed `Default` agent for an organization cannot be deleted and returns 400.

get.description: Returns every (vendor, model) pair the router knows about per pipeline layer, plus one vendor-wildcard row per vendor. The `id` field on each entry is the verbatim string callers put into `allowedProviders` on session create, transcribe, synthesize, complete, or `stackPreferences` on an agent. Use this to populate UI pickers or validate user-supplied allowlists.

region.description: Region whose streaming-latency measurements should be used. `global` falls through to batch-mode rows when no per-region data matches.

allowedProviders.description: Restrict candidate pool per modality. Router still ranks by score. Each entry is either `"<vendor>"` (vendor wildcard — allow any model from that vendor) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (allow only that specific model). Failover stays active across all entries in the layer.

items.description: Allowed STT provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"deepgram"` — any Deepgram model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"deepgram:nova-3"` — only Nova-3, no fallback to other Deepgram models within the vendor). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.
Allowed LLM provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"openai"` — any OpenAI model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"openai:gpt-5"` — only that model). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.

Allowed TTS provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"elevenlabs"` — any ElevenLabs model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"elevenlabs:eleven_flash_v2_5"` — only that model). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.

Allowed S2S provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"openai"` — any OpenAI realtime model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"openai:gpt-realtime"` — only that model). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.

CreateSessionRequest.description: Cascade-mode session creation body. Exactly one of `agentId` or `intent` must be supplied. When `agentId` is given, the persisted agent's `systemPrompt`, `voice`, `intent`, and `llmOptions` seed the session as defaults; any per-call field on this body still overrides the agent's stored value.

agentId.description: Optional pointer to a persisted `agent` row whose fields seed this session. When supplied, the agent's `systemPrompt`, `voice`, `intent`, and `llmOptions` become defaults; any per-call field on this body overrides the agent's stored value. When absent, `intent` is required.

voice.description: Force a specific TTS voice id.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value pairs stored on the session row.

conversationToken.description: LiveKit JWT for the browser to join the room.

voice.description: Provider-specific voice id. Speko falls back to a sane default per provider when omitted.

systemPrompt.description: Forwarded via the canonical system-prompt slot. Don't *also* prepend the same content as a `system` message.

AgentIntent.description: Routing defaults stored on an agent row. Hydrated into a session's `RoutingIntent` when the session is created with `agentId` and no inline `intent`. Note: agents accept a smaller `optimizeFor` enum than the per-session `RoutingIntent`.

AgentLlmOptions.description: Optional LLM tuning defaults stored on an agent. Strict object — only these three keys are accepted.

model.description: Pin a specific LLM model id. When omitted, the router picks per intent.

Agent.description: Reusable voice persona — `systemPrompt` + optional `voice` + routing `intent` defaults, plus optional `llmOptions`. Pass the `id` as `agentId` on `POST /v1/sessions` to seed a session from this agent.

organizationId.description: Owning organization. Always equal to the authenticated org — agents are never visible across orgs.

name.description: Human-readable name. Unique within an organization.

systemPrompt.description: Initial agent instructions. Hydrated as the session's `systemPrompt` default when no per-call value is supplied.

voice.description: Default TTS voice id. `null` when unset — the router picks a sane default per provider.

llmOptions.description: Optional LLM tuning defaults. `null` when unset.

stackPreferences.description: Per-agent stack preferences. `null` when the agent has no preferences set.

name.description: Human-readable name. Must be unique within the organization — duplicates return 409.

systemPrompt.description: Initial agent instructions used as the session-level `systemPrompt` default.

voice.description: Default TTS voice id. Omit to let the router pick per provider.

UpdateAgentRequest.description: Partial update — every field is optional. Only supplied keys are written. The seed `Default` agent's `name` cannot be changed.

name.description: Human-readable name. Must remain unique within the organization.

AgentStackPreferences.description: Per-agent stack preferences. Empty / missing layers leave the router unconstrained for that layer; failover stays active within the allowed set.

allowedProviders.description: Per-pipeline-layer provider allowlists (e.g. STT must be Deepgram or AssemblyAI). Each entry is either `"<vendor>"` (vendor wildcard — allow any model from that vendor) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (allow only that specific model). Failover stays active across all entries in the layer.

items.description: Allowed STT provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"deepgram"` — any Deepgram model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"deepgram:nova-3"` — only Nova-3, no fallback to other Deepgram models within the vendor). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.

stt.description: Allowed STT provider entries. Empty / absent = no constraint.

items.description: Allowed LLM provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"openai"` — any OpenAI model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"openai:gpt-5"` — only that model). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.

llm.description: Allowed LLM provider entries. Empty / absent = no constraint.

items.description: Allowed TTS provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"elevenlabs"` — any ElevenLabs model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"elevenlabs:eleven_flash_v2_5"` — only that model). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.

tts.description: Allowed TTS provider entries. Empty / absent = no constraint.

ProviderModelEntry.description: A single allowlist-eligible entry returned by `/v1/providers/known`. The `id` is the verbatim string callers put into `allowedProviders` — either a vendor wildcard (`"deepgram"`) or a specific (vendor, model) pair (`"deepgram:nova-3"`).

id.description: Verbatim string for `allowedProviders` entries. `"<vendor>"` for vendor-wildcard rows, `"<vendor>:<model>"` for model-specific rows.

model.description: Model id within the vendor, or `null` for the vendor-wildcard row.

benchmarked.description: Whether the router has benchmark data for this entry. `false` entries are visible but cannot win selection — including them in `allowedProviders` without a benchmarked fallback will fail to route.

KnownProviders.description: Per-modality lists of allowlist-eligible entries. Each layer's array contains one vendor-wildcard row per known vendor plus one row per known (vendor, model) pair. Use the `id` field as the verbatim string for `allowedProviders`.

nextCursor.description: Cursor to pass to the next call. Null/absent when there are no more pages.

pipelineConfig.description: Snapshot of the pipeline config the session was minted with.

agentId.description: The agent the session was started against, if any. Filtered on by the `?agent=` query param.

ValidationError.description: Request body or query parameters failed validation.

InvalidAudio.description: Empty body, missing/invalid `x-speko-intent` header, or malformed `x-speko-constraints`.

TranscribeFailed.description: No STT provider available for the intent, or every candidate failed.

SynthesizeFailed.description: No TTS provider available for the intent, no default voice for chosen provider, or every candidate failed.

CompleteFailed.description: No LLM provider available for the intent, or every candidate failed.

SessionCreateFailed.description: Token mint failed, agent dispatch failed, or DB insert failed.

AgentNotFound.description: No agent with this id exists in the authenticated organization.

AgentNameConflict.description: Another agent in the same organization already uses this name.

value.error: Agent with this name already exists

AgentDeleteForbidden.description: The seed `Default` agent for an organization cannot be deleted.

value.error: Cannot delete the Default agent for this organization
